review_evidence: README identifies LeanTest as a Lean 4 unit-testing framework with fluent tests, assertions, IO/error checks, suites and terminal reporting.

The LeanTest modules define the testing API and assertion machinery, while example files give concrete formal uses of those interfaces; test/example naming is not by itself a lossless-exclusion argument.
The package uses lakefile.toml and the shell runner is non-primary, so no maintenance-only current-primary Lean file was established.
summary: Retain the LeanTest framework and its formal usage examples; no safe hard exclusion was established.
